name: nftato-panel
description: Nftato防火墙规则多服务器管理面板

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:nftato && cd client && npm run build
scripts.test:firewall: docker build -t gnftato-firewall-test -f tests/Dockerfile tests && docker run --rm --privileged --network none -v "$PWD:/workspace:ro" gnftato-firewall-test
scripts.test: node --test server/test/*.test.js && npm test --prefix client && bash tests/nftato-unit.sh
